http/http1_reading#

Reading HTTP/1.1 heads from a stream, keeping whatever was read past them.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let read = await Http1RequestHeadReading(socket_input).head();
read.head();                          // the Http1RequestHead
read.remainder();                     // bytes of the body already read

Description#

Reading HTTP/1.1 heads from a stream, keeping whatever was read past them.

A failure part way may have consumed input: the connection is then discarded.
